question: Give me a 20-degree latitude/longitude grid and count how many airports fall in each populated cell
sql: WITH grid AS (SELECT lon_start, lat_start, ST_MakeEnvelope(lon_start, lat_start, lon_start+20, lat_start+20) AS geom FROM (SELECT generate_series(-180,160,20) AS lon_start) l CROSS JOIN (SELECT generate_series(-60,60,20) AS lat_start) la) SELECT lon_start, lat_start, COUNT(*) AS airport_count FROM grid JOIN airports ON ST_Within(airports.geometry, grid.geom) GROUP BY lon_start, lat_start HAVING COUNT(*)>0 ORDER BY airport_count DESC LIMIT 50

question: List how many airports are in the northern hemisphere versus the southern hemisphere
sql: WITH hemis AS (SELECT 'Northern' AS name, ST_MakeEnvelope(-180,0,180,90) AS geom UNION ALL SELECT 'Southern', ST_MakeEnvelope(-180,-90,0,0)) SELECT h.name, COUNT(a.name) AS airport_count FROM hemis h JOIN airports a ON ST_Within(a.geometry, h.geom) GROUP BY h.name

question: Compare the number of airports in the western hemisphere with the eastern hemisphere
sql: WITH hemis AS (SELECT 'Western' AS name, ST_MakeEnvelope(-180,-90,0,90) AS geom UNION ALL SELECT 'Eastern', ST_MakeEnvelope(0,-90,180,90)) SELECT h.name, COUNT(*) AS airport_count FROM hemis h JOIN airports a ON ST_Within(a.geometry, h.geom) GROUP BY h.name

question: For each airport type, give the number of airports and the bounding box of all its locations as GeoJSON
sql: SELECT type, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Extent_Agg(geometry)) AS extent_geojson FROM airports GROUP BY type ORDER BY cnt DESC

question: List the ten airports that have the most other airports within 500 km
sql: SELECT a.name AS airport, COUNT(*) AS neighbors_within_500km FROM airports a JOIN airports b ON a.name <> b.name AND ST_Distance_Spheroid(a.geometry, b.geometry) <= 500000 GROUP BY a.name ORDER BY neighbors_within_500km DESC LIMIT 10

question: Give the count of airports per scalerank and the centroid of each group as GeoJSON
sql: SELECT scalerank, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ST_AsGeoJSON(ST_Centroid(ST_Union_Agg(geometry))) AS centroid_geojson FROM airports GROUP BY scalerank ORDER BY scalerank
